title: Deal for 65 Inch TV for Gaming
body:
Looking for the best deals for a 65 inch tv specifically for gaming….. haven’t played my ps5 in years but gta has just come out and I want to get the most out of it!
I was looking at a tcl 65c6l for $1200 but then seen a post on here that it was around $850 a month or so ago so feel like I’m getting ripped paying $1200 haha
Anything special that anyone can recommend?
